title: Static Locked-Off
description: A static locked-off shot plants the camera on a heavy tripod with zero camera movement. Composition, blocking, and duration do the work; the frame is a living picture that does not tour.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Trust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise.

Comedy, ritual, and dread all live here because the audience cannot be rescued by a pan when something enters, or fails to enter, the rectangle. It is the wrong tool when geography must be discovered in motion, and the wrong tool if you add a slider 'for life' and destroy the contract.
Silence of the head is a relationship to the action, not a frozen audio file.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Heavy sticks, locked head, level bubble, no touch after slate. Actors and air may move; the camera may not.
Prompt a perfectly static locked-off shot, heavy tripod, zero camera movement, composition doing all the work.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when blocking and duration should carry the beat and movement would be noise. Concrete beat: a domestic task held in a fixed composition until the task changes meaning.
Do not drift.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Tableau is a related still, often more presentational. A Long Take may be static or moving; length is not the lock-off.
Any dolly, pan, or zoom leaves this family. Static is zero camera path.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Jeanne Dielman holds domestic tasks in fixed compositions. Tokyo Story lets rooms and sitting do the motion.
The Grand Budapest Hotel uses lock-offs as diagram. 2001: A Space Odyssey plants some spacecraft views as still geometry.
Grammar of the rectangle, not a kitchen to copy.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Perfectly static locked-off shot of [Subject], heavy tripod, zero camera movement, composition doing all the work, living-picture stillness. For motion: completely locked-off camera.
[Subject] may breathe or the air may move, but the frame does not.

In a dark archive, a librarian listens for someone outside. Remove music entirely and retain only quiet ventilation, cloth movement and her restrained breathing. Let the ventilation stop, leaving a single distant latch click clearly exposed. No sudden monster reveal or oversized bass hit.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a tiny Slider Shot or a breathing Handheld. The tell is any parallax or micro-pan.
The fix: locked head, no virtual drift, action inside a still frame.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Static Locked-Off in film?
It is a shot with no camera movement: the support is locked and only the world or the actors may move inside the composition.
Static Locked-Off vs Long Take
A long take is about duration and may travel. A static lock-off is about a frozen camera, whether the shot is 3 seconds or 3 minutes.
When should I use Static Locked-Off?
When blocking, comedy, or dread should happen inside a decided rectangle. Do not slide 'to add life' if the contract is stillness.
How do I prompt Static Locked-Off for AI image or video?
Write completely locked-off camera, heavy tripod, zero camera movement. Subject may breathe. Ban pan, dolly, zoom, and drift.
